top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a new, tunable regime of quantum matter: the quantitative flat-band prediction at a magic angle followed by the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, reproduced by many groups and device geometries. The citation can be restricted to what is secure (flat bands and the observed phases, no pairing-mechanism claim). I weigh the unresolved experimental credit beyond Jarillo-Herrero (Dean, the 2018 first author, Young, Yacoby, Efetov, Yazdani) and eight years of maturity as real costs, but they do not outweigh the breadth of the discovery. P001 (optical lattice clock, Katori and Ye) is a mature, cleanly attributed second choice and a clearly better outcome than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; field proximity only to astroparticle and detector work, with no documented tie to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer
